{{Quote|Hand over your weapons.|translated=1|The Rodian to Kyle Katarn|<ref name="JO" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Rodian''' served as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] for the corpulent [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Reelo Baruk]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. The Rodian worked at [[Baruk's Bar|Baruk's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and would work with [[Unidentified Rodian (Baruk's bar)|another Rodian]] to act as doormen to the cantina, where their duties included confiscating weapons from conspicuous guests. The Rodian was eventually [[Death/Legends|slain]] during a [[lightfight]] with [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]], who was looking for Baruk.

==Biography==
[[File:Bouncers.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Rodian, right, and his partner]]
The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]<ref name="JO" /> was active as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="JO2">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' game manual</ref> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="JO-Date" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. At some point, the Rodian was hired by the corpulent Rodian [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Reelo Baruk]]. The Rodian was eventually employed to [[Baruk's Bar]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and together with [[Unidentified Rodian (Baruk's bar)|another Rodian]] he acted as a doorman. The pair of Rodians would hang out in the [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] and welcome arriving guests, while confiscating their weapons. When Baruk began supplying weapons and mercenaries to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces of [[Galak Fyyar]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Desann]], the crime boss had attracted the attention of the New Republic government, who were engaged in a conflict with Fyyar's forces.<ref name="JO" />

[[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] was eventually dispatched to Nar Shaddaa to find and eliminate Baruk. Katarn first went to Baruk's Bar to look for leads, and upon entering he was greeted by the Rodian bounty hunter and his partner. The Rodian confiscated Katarn's [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]] and other weapons before allowing Katarn entry into the cantina. The Rodian, however, failed to acquire Katarn's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When Katarn was double-crossed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], [[Baldarek]], the bounty hunters turned on Katarn with their own weapons. The Rodian, having taken Katarn's weapons to a room above the bar area, rushed into the fray with an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. The Rodian, and all of the other bounty hunters and cantina patrons, were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Katarn. The bartender was spared, however, after Katarn extracted further information from him. Eventually, with the help of a man named [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], Katarn ended Baruk's part in the war.<ref name="JO" />

==Personality and traits==
The Rodian was abrupt and too the point when it came to confiscating Katarn's weapons. When violence broke out in the bar, the Rodian was quick to join the fray, eager to fight. The Rodian wore a white [[Clothing/Legends|jumpsuit]] and used an E-11 blaster rifle when he fought Katarn. While he was proficient with the rifle, but was unable to kill Katarn with it. The Rodian had green skin and bluish-green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="JO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''. During the first level that took place on Nar Shaddaa, he was the first non-player character to have spoken dialogue. While enemies can be routinely disarmed throughout the game and be left unharmed, this Rodian, as well as all bounty hunters during his portion of the level, had to be killed in order to trigger the next cutscene. All Rodians were voiced by either [[Michael Gough]] or [[Tom Kane]], credited as Rodian 2 and Rodian 1 respectively. It is not clear what Rodian this one was, although he was the first one to speak.<ref name="JO" />
